requires: Level 56+; a piece of Vestheiel's remains
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Vestheiel's remains sit at a table of a thousand empty chairs; recite back every rule spoken on the floors below and take the seal from its dead hand.
secret: Five strangers must have independently adopted a personal code you wrote, without ever meeting you.
notice: [A Code kept by many becomes a Rule. Legendary class: Warden of the Common Word.]
blurb: Follows Vestheiel, the Nameless Shade of Rules, who turned private codes into customs whole peoples kept without knowing who wrote them.
features: Skill: Spoken Accord
Once per short rest, declare a rule within 60 feet (no flight, no healing, no spells above 5th level); a creature that breaks it takes 8d10 psychic damage (Wisdom save halves).
Skill: Reputation Precedes
Creatures that have heard of you have disadvantage on their first attack against you each combat, and allies sworn to your rules gain +1 AC.
Ultimate: Law of the Many
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, every rule you declared today applies at once in a 120 foot radius, and you ignore their penalties.
evolves: If a whole city adopts one of your rules, it becomes a standing ward over that city that needs no upkeep.
cost: You are bound by every rule you declare; break one and the class goes silent for a month.

requires: Level 89+; a piece of Iron's remains
unlock: On the Unlit Spire's 89th floor, Iron's last saber lies half drawn in a dead grip; finish the draw in one motion before the floor below fades from your memory.
secret: You must have ended a duel with a single draw strike, the blade back in its sheath before the body fell.
notice: [One draw. One cut. One heir. Legendary class: Sheathed Crescent.]
blurb: Follows Iron through the curved road of the Saber, where the draw itself is the weapon and the shape is only its shadow.
features: Skill: Moonrise Draw
Your first attack each combat is a draw strike that is automatically a critical hit and deals an extra 10d10 slashing damage.
Skill: Scabbard Breath
While your blade is sheathed you gain +2 AC, and you can answer any attack made within 15 feet of you with a draw strike as a reaction.
Ultimate: Thousand Sheaths in One
Once per long rest, make one draw strike against every creature you can see within 120 feet; each takes 25d10 slashing damage.
evolves: If you cross blades with Blade's heir and both live, your draw strike can cut a Law's effect as cleanly as flesh.
cost: A blade left drawn for more than 1 minute turns on you, dealing 4d10 slashing damage each round until sheathed.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Nytheane's remains
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire the singing stops around Nytheane's remains; weep there until the choir sings your grief back to you, then take the tear-stone from its chest.
secret: You must have grieved a loss for a full year without once turning that grief into anger.
notice: [Grief, and only grief. The choir falls silent for you. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Nytheane, the Restless Heart of Sadness, the part of Dark that was boiled down to sorrow and nothing else.
features: Skill: Grief Made Whole
You have resistance to necrotic and psychic damage, and creatures within 30 feet that are below half hit points have disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you.
Skill: Shared Mourning
Once per short rest, when an ally within 60 feet is hit, you take the damage instead and the attacker takes 6d8 psychic damage.
Ultimate: The Long Lament
Once per long rest, you sing a 60 foot dirge for 1 minute; enemies who fail a Wisdom save each turn fall to their knees, incapacitated and weeping.
evolves: If you mourn one hundred strangers no one else would, the dirge also raises their shades to fight beside you once.
cost: You cannot feel joy; checks to celebrate, cheer or comfort with happiness automatically fail.

requires: Level 1+; the trace Vesraael left behind
unlock: On the top floor of the Milestone Spire a mirror shows a second face beside yours; point out every object in the room that the mirror hides, and Vesraael's trace looks back through your eyes.
secret: You must have found something another person lost without being told what it was.
notice: [Something is there. That is enough. Legendary class: Twice-Glancing Lookout.]
blurb: Follows Vesraael, the Twin-Faced Shade of Scan, who never learned what anything was, only that it was there.
features: Skill: Ping
As an action, you learn whether any creature or object of a kind you name is within 60 feet, but not where or what exactly.
Skill: Second Face
You cannot be surprised while conscious, and you gain +2 to initiative.
Ultimate: Twin-Faced Sweep
Once per long rest, for 10 minutes, you sense every creature, trap and hidden door within 300 feet, though not their nature.
evolves: If you ever stand beside Identify's heir, your Ping also names the thing it finds.
cost: You can never stop looking; you only finish a long rest in a fully enclosed room.

requires: Level 34+; the trace Life left behind
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire lies a body covered in scars that rearrange every hour; find the one scar Life left behind and trace it with a finger through a full reshuffle.
secret: You must carry at least ten scars you refused to have magically erased.
notice: [The wound is closed. The memory is not. Legendary class: Keeper of Closed Wounds.]
blurb: Follows Life down the narrow road of the Scar, the mark that remains after healing has done its work and the blade is long gone.
features: Skill: Scar Ledger
When a creature lands a critical hit on you, you gain a scar for it; you have resistance to that creature's damage forever after.
Skill: Reopen
As an action, touch a creature: its old wounds tear open for 8d10 necrotic damage, doubled if it was healed in the last hour.
Ultimate: What Healing Leaves
Once per long rest, every wound you took this combat is written onto an enemy within 60 feet as force damage equal to half the total (Constitution save halves again).
evolves: If you carry a scar from every realm tier you have climbed, the Ledger also grants immunity against your oldest enemy.
cost: Healing on you restores only half; the rest becomes another scar.

requires: Level 1+; a piece of Nyluur's remains
unlock: On the top floor of the Milestone Spire, Nyluur's remains lie beneath a field of a hundred flowers; find them blindfolded, by smell alone.
secret: You must have tracked an animal for a full day without once laying eyes on it.
notice: [Trail acquired. The road bends, but the scent does not. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Nyluur, the Strange Shade of Scent, who refined plain Smell until it could follow a single soul across a country.
features: Skill: Keen Trail
You have advantage on Perception and Survival checks that use smell, and you can follow a scent up to one day old.
Skill: Smell of Fear
You smell creatures within 30 feet even when they are invisible, and you know which of them are below half hit points.
Ultimate: Strange Shade's Hunt
Once per long rest, mark a creature by its scent; for 24 hours you know its direction and distance up to 1 mile, and your attacks against it deal an extra 1d8 damage.
evolves: If you follow a trail across three realms without losing it, you can track thoughts and intentions as easily as bodies.
cost: Strong odours overwhelm you; smoke, sewers and perfumed halls give you disadvantage on everything.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Eirdoix's remains
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Eirdoix's remains still hold court and mock every climber; endure its contempt without answering in heat, then answer once, coldly, to end it.
secret: You must have calmly refused forgiveness to someone who begged for it three times.
notice: [Beneath your notice. Beneath your mercy. Legendary class: Coldbrow Hexer.]
blurb: Follows Eirdoix, the Unquiet Heart of Scorn, the splinter of Dark colder and more patient than Anger ever learned to be.
features: Skill: Withering Regard
As a bonus action, curse a creature you can see; your attacks against it deal an extra 4d8 necrotic damage and it cannot benefit from morale or inspiration.
Skill: Beneath Notice
A creature you have cursed has disadvantage on attacks against you, and its first hit each round deals no damage.
Ultimate: The Final Dismissal
Once per long rest, a cursed creature makes a Wisdom save or is dismissed for 1 minute: its allies cannot help it, its spells fail, and it takes double damage.
evolves: If you scorn a god to its face and survive, your curses work on contract holders up to 1st Finger.
cost: Spells and help from allies have only half effect on you; contempt runs both ways.

requires: Level 67+; the trace Liosael left behind
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire stands a machine of loose plates; drive Liosael's last screw home a quarter turn at each sunrise until it holds.
secret: You must have built something that held together without nails, glue or magic.
notice: [Turn by turn, it holds. Legendary class: Threadwright of the Bound Horizon.]
blurb: Follows Liosael, the Nameless Shade of Screw, who preferred binding things fast to breaking them apart.
features: Skill: Bind Fast
Your attacks drive spiral bolts: a hit creature's speed is halved and it cannot teleport until your next turn. Constructs you build gain +2 AC.
Skill: Quarter Turn
As a bonus action, tighten a bolt: the bound creature takes 8d10 piercing damage and is restrained (Strength save ends).
Ultimate: Riveted Sky
Once per long rest, pin up to six creatures within 120 feet in place; they are restrained for 1 minute and take 10d10 piercing damage each turn they struggle.
evolves: If you bind a Fusion that was coming apart, Liosael's trace teaches you to screw a Law into a weapon permanently.
cost: Everything you bind needs upkeep; skip an hour of tightening on a long rest and your gear loses its bonuses.

requires: Level 1+; the trace Iron left behind
unlock: A wheat field grows on the top floor of the Milestone Spire; harvest every stalk with the scythe Iron left behind before the tower's false sun sets.
secret: You must have worked a full harvest season by hand.
notice: [The field is cut. The harvest knows you. Legendary class: Reaper of the Lower Field.]
blurb: Follows Iron along the harvest road of the Scythe, a farmer's tool that wandered onto the battlefield and stayed.
features: Skill: Wide Swath
Attacks with a scythe, sickle or polearm also hit a second adjacent creature for half damage.
Skill: Harvest Rhythm
Each consecutive turn you hit, you gain +1 to hit (maximum +3) until you miss.
Ultimate: Last Sheaf
Once per long rest, sweep a 15 foot circle for 4d8 slashing damage; you gain temporary hit points equal to the levels of creatures it drops.
evolves: If you bring in a harvest that ends a famine, the blade learns to reap curses as well as grain.
cost: Plants wither in a small ring wherever you sleep.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Selvaune left behind
unlock: On the top floor of the Choir Spire stands a choir of statues; Selvaune's test is the one that answers back, and you must convince it that it is alive.
secret: You must have named and spoken to a tool every day for a year, treating it as a companion.
notice: [Threshold crossed. It knows itself now. Legendary class: Awakener of Idle Things.]
blurb: Follows Selvaune, the Unknown Shade of Sentience, who stood on the line between an Entity and a tool and pushed things across it.
features: Skill: Spark of Self
Touch an object for 1 minute and it becomes sentient for 1 hour, fighting as your ally with a challenge rating up to a quarter of your level.
Skill: Who Am I
You and awakened allies have advantage on saves against charm and domination, and you always know whether a creature is truly sentient.
Ultimate: Threshold of Many
Once per long rest, awaken every object within 60 feet for 1 minute; up to ten weapons and tools attack your enemies for 3d10 damage each.
evolves: If an object you awakened chooses to stay awake forever, it becomes a lasting companion with a class of its own.
cost: Things remember you; mistreat any tool and every awakened object turns against you for a day.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Quotath's remains
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Quotath's corpse is fused to a debt plaque; pull the two apart without tearing either.
secret: You must have ended a partnership in which both sides walked away satisfied.
notice: [What was joined is two again. Legendary class: Unjoiner of the Iron Ledger.]
blurb: Follows Quotath, the Nameless Shade of Separation, who pulled apart what Fusion joined, never quite as cleanly.
features: Skill: Part Ways
As an action, sever one bond on a creature within 60 feet: a grapple, a possession, a summoner's link or a concentration spell (contested check).
Skill: Clean Cut
Once per short rest, cut an enemy away from its allies: it teleports to a space within 60 feet of your choice.
Ultimate: The Great Unmaking
Once per long rest, a fused or merged creature within 60 feet splits into its parts; any other creature has spirit torn from body for 1 round, incapacitated and taking 8d10 force damage.
evolves: If you separate a Fusion that a god made, Quotath's trace lets you split a contract from its holder.
cost: Bonds fray around you; you can never attune to more than two items.

requires: Level 12+; the trace Ryniel left behind
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, every reflection in the mist panics; sit still until every one of them calms, and Ryniel's trace settles into your breathing.
secret: You must have gone a full year without raising your voice.
notice: [Stillness confirmed. Nothing moves you. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Ryniel, the Restless Heart of Serenity, the stillest splinter of Light, with neither the reach of Hope nor the heat of Love.
features: Skill: Still Center
While you move no more than half your speed on a turn, you are immune to being frightened or charmed.
Skill: Quiet Palm
Your unarmed hit can end one emotion effect on the target and knock it prone (Strength save).
Ultimate: Unrippled
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, creatures within 30 feet cannot take reactions, and hostile ones must make a Wisdom save or lose the will to fight.
evolves: If you calm a battle between two armies without a blow, the stillness spreads to a whole town for a day.
cost: If you ever lose your temper, every feature fails until your next long rest.

n: Kneeling Hand of the Empty Throne
requires: Level 89+; a piece of Eirlun's remains
unlock: On the Unlit Spire's 89th floor, Eirlun's corpse still kneels before an empty throne; kneel beside it and serve the throne for a full day without asking why.
secret: You must have served a master for ten years who never once thanked you.
notice: [Service accepted. The throne needs no king. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Eirlun, the Twin-Faced Shade of Servitude, the condition of everyone without Royalty behind them, and the root of every pact.
features: Skill: Borrowed Might
Name a master (a god, patron or ally); you use their spell save DC and share all their damage resistances.
Skill: Take the Blow
When your master or an ally within 60 feet is hit, you teleport beside them and take the hit for half damage.
Ultimate: The Kneeling Crown
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, your master's full power flows into you: cast one of their spells each turn without a slot, or use their highest contract ability.
evolves: If you outlive your master and serve no one after, the empty throne lets you sit on it once.
cost: Without a named master you have disadvantage on every roll.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Orvael's remains
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire the light flips every hour; stand in Orvael's cast shadow at the moment no light exists to cast it.
secret: You must have lived a full month without lighting a lamp or fire.
notice: [Not dark. Only absent. Legendary class: Penumbra Walker.]
blurb: Follows Orvael, the Hidden Shade of Shade, cast by Dark but never made of it, closer to an absence of Light than a Law.
features: Skill: Absence Step
As a bonus action, teleport up to 60 feet between areas of dim light or darkness.
Skill: Light-Eater
Once per short rest, create a 30 foot zone of absence for 1 minute: magical light fails and creatures without truesight are blinded, except you.
Ultimate: Casting No Shadow
Once per long rest, become a shade for 1 minute: resistance to all damage except radiant, and your attacks deal an extra 6d10 cold damage.
evolves: If you stand in Light's own shadow, your zone can swallow radiant damage as well.
cost: Sunlight burns you: disadvantage and 1d10 radiant damage each turn you stand in it.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Zeniiel's remains
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Zeniiel's corpse casts a shade under the brightest light; let it peel free and attach itself to you as your own shadow.
secret: You must have stayed beside a dying stranger until their shade left them.
notice: [Your shadow is no longer yours. Legendary class: Corpse-Shade Revenant.]
blurb: Follows Zeniiel, the Forgotten Shade of Shadow, condensed from what a corpse leaves behind: weak in a fair fight and nearly impossible to hit.
features: Skill: Formless Guard
Attacks against you have disadvantage while you stand in dim light, and you gain +1 AC.
Skill: Shadow Pin
As an action, your shadow pins the shadow of a creature within 30 feet; its speed becomes 0 (Strength save ends).
Ultimate: Untouchable Shade
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you shed your body: only critical hits can harm you, and your touch deals 6d10 necrotic damage.
evolves: If you raise a Shadow from a fallen hero's shade, it fights beside you with that hero's skill.
cost: Your weapon damage is halved; you cannot win a straight fight.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Liosaane left behind
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Liosaane's test is a choir singing your lineage; find the missing verse and sing it.
secret: You must have a Shaman ancestor, or have been accepted as kin by a spirit of the Spirit Realm.
notice: [Your blood remembers the Spirit Realm. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Liosaane, the Unknown Shade of Shaman, a bloodline rather than a Law, born closer to the Spirit Realm than any ordinary mortal.
features: Skill: Thin Veil
You see and speak with spirits; once per short rest, an ancestor spirit grants you advantage on one roll.
Skill: Progenitor's Echo
Any feature you or an ally within 30 feet has that is tied to a progenitor rolls one extra damage or healing die.
Ultimate: Choir of Forebears
Once per long rest, summon your ancestors in a 30 foot radius for 1 minute: allies heal 2d10 each turn and enemies take 2d10 radiant damage.
evolves: If you meet a living progenitor, your bloodline lets you speak to it as kin, not as a stranger.
cost: Spirits want offerings; skip a day and their whispers deny you a long rest.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Nyroth left behind
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire stand thirty identical climbers, one of them Nyroth's leftover; find it, then let it wear you.
secret: You must have lived a week as someone else without being found out.
notice: [Shape stored. Whose face is this? Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Nyroth, the Forgotten Shade of Shape-shifter, a rare summon that kept a quarter of its power and a borrowed cousin of Transformation.
features: Skill: Absorbed Form
When you kill a creature you may store its shape; as an action, take a stored shape of challenge rating up to half your level, keeping your mind.
Skill: Quarter Echo
While in a stored shape, you can use one of its abilities at a quarter of its original strength.
Ultimate: Wearing the Debt
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, take the shape of a creature you touched in the last hour, including its class features.
evolves: If you store a hundred shapes, you may wear two at once.
cost: After each change make a Wisdom save or lose a memory of your own face.

requires: Level 67+; a piece of Iron's remains
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Iron's broken shield lies on a plain under endless arrows; carry it across, raising it only over others and never over yourself.
secret: You must have taken a killing blow meant for someone else and survived.
notice: [Stop. Not cut. Legendary class: Bulwark of the Far Plain.]
blurb: Follows Iron along the Shield, the defensive twin of Blade, drawn from the same metal but shaped to stop.
features: Skill: Twin of the Blade
You gain +2 AC with a shield, and as a reaction you reduce damage to an ally within 30 feet by 4d10 plus your level.
Skill: Totem Wall
Once per short rest, plant your shield to raise a 30 foot dome for 1 minute that enemies cannot pass through.
Ultimate: Nothing Passes
Once per long rest, for 1 round, no attack, spell or effect crosses a 120 foot line you choose.
evolves: If you free Iron, the shield becomes the first Primary-tier Iron shield of this age.
cost: You can never hold a weapon in your shield hand, and you cannot flee while an ally remains in the fight.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Sylph left behind
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire hangs a brass plaque crackling with Sylph's trace; touch it bare-handed once every hour for a day.
secret: You must have been struck by lightning and lived.
notice: [Release confirmed. Short and sharp. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Sylph through the Twin-Faced Shade of Shock, a short sharp release that rides Electric without belonging to it.
features: Skill: Short Release
When a creature hits you in melee, it takes 3d8 lightning damage.
Skill: Snap
As an action, release a 60 foot line of 6d8 lightning damage; creatures that fail a Dexterity save are stunned until your next turn.
Ultimate: Discharge
Once per long rest, release everything in a 30 foot radius: 12d8 lightning damage and stunned for 1 round; you cannot cast spells next turn.
evolves: If you catch a storm in your hands at sea, Discharge can be held and released a second time.
cost: Metal bites you; wearing metal armour deals 1d8 lightning damage to you each turn in combat.

requires: Level 100+; the trace Orrios left behind
unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Orrios left a stair that grows shorter as you climb; reach the step of no height at all and stand on it.
secret: You must have hidden something so well that you forgot where it was.
notice: [Distance shortened to zero. Legendary class: Keeper of the Last Inch.]
blurb: Follows Orrios, the Twin-Faced Shade of Shorter, the favourite of everything meant to be concealed or cut short.
features: Skill: Abbreviate
You can shorten any distance you travel, any range of a hostile effect, or the duration of an enemy spell to a tenth of its value.
Skill: Concealing Fold
Shrink to any size down to 1 inch, keeping your full strength; only truesight can find you.
Ultimate: The Short End
Once per long rest, cut a creature's story short: if it has 300 hit points or fewer it drops to 0 (Constitution save negates if above half).
evolves: If you cut short a war before it starts, Orrios's other face shows you how to make things longer as well.
cost: Your own life runs shorter: you age one year each time you use The Short End.

requires: Level 56+; a piece of Quokaane's remains
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Quokaane's corpse holds a dead beacon; relight it so that every climber on all sixty floors notices it at once.
secret: You must have sent a warning that saved lives without ever explaining it.
notice: [Noticed. Not understood. That is enough. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Quokaane, the Strange Shade of Signal, a narrow Transmission meant to be noticed rather than understood.
features: Skill: Unmissable
You can make any creature you choose within 10 miles notice you, knowing your direction and whether you mean help or harm.
Skill: Flare
As an action, creatures within 60 feet make a Constitution save or are blinded for 1 round; allies gain advantage on their next attack.
Ultimate: All Eyes Here
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, every creature within 1 mile notices a point you choose; enemies who fail a Wisdom save must move toward it.
evolves: If a signal of yours stops a war, it can carry across realms.
cost: You can never hide; you have disadvantage on every Stealth check.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Cosmic left behind
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire the rings converge to one point where Cosmic's trace waits; meditate until your body collapses into it, then climb back out.
secret: You must have held one breath, thought or grudge for a hundred days without letting it go.
notice: [Collapse complete. Return accepted. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Cosmic down its most extreme road, the Singularity, a piece of Cosmic that fell entirely inward and is too unstable for most to hold.
features: Skill: Edge of the Fall
Creatures within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Strength save to move away from you.
Skill: Collapse Strike
Your unarmed hits deal an extra 4d10 force damage and pull the target 15 feet toward you.
Ultimate: Inward Fall
Once per long rest, become a point of infinite weight for 1 round: everything within 60 feet is dragged to you and takes 20d10 force damage, and you take 5d10.
evolves: If you master the collapse for a full year, you can fold a whole battlefield into a single step.
cost: After each Collapse Strike that kills, make a Constitution save or gain a level of exhaustion.

n: Quiet Leech of the Sunken Stair
requires: Level 45+; the trace Eirsaor left behind
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, Eirsaor left a reservoir drained drop by drop; refill it using only power siphoned from others, without any of them noticing.
secret: You must have stolen something that was never missed.
notice: [Drawn. Unnoticed. Legendary class: Quiet Leech of the Sunken Stair.]
blurb: Follows Eirsaor, the Unknown Shade of Siphon, a slower and quieter Theft that empties a target before it knows to struggle.
features: Skill: Slow Draw
Each of your hits silently drains 2d10 hit points or one spell slot level; the target does not notice until the fight ends.
Skill: Reservoir
You store up to your level in drained energy and can spend it to recover hit points or spell slots.
Ultimate: Empty Well
Once per long rest, a creature within 60 feet loses all unspent spell slots and class resources; you gain half of them.
evolves: If you drain a god's contractor dry, the Reservoir can hold a contract for a day.
cost: Your own resources never recover on a rest; only what you siphon refills you.

requires: Level 12+; the trace Orniael left behind
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Orniael's test is a mist full of loose bones; assemble one complete skeleton by touch alone.
secret: You must have buried twenty corpses with your own hands.
notice: [The frame stands. The bones answer. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Orniael, the Strange Shade of Skeleton, master of the weakest summon: any corpse, a twentieth of its power, all body and no magic.
features: Skill: Raise the Frame
Raise up to four skeletons from corpses; each keeps a twentieth of the original's power and can only fight physically.
Skill: Brittle Legion
Your skeletons gain +2 to hit, and when one is destroyed it bursts for 2d6 piercing damage around it.
Ultimate: Ossuary March
Once per long rest, raise every corpse within 120 feet as a skeleton for 1 hour.
evolves: If you raise a skeleton from a progenitor's bones, it keeps a twentieth of that progenitor's Law.
cost: The living fear you; you have disadvantage on Charisma checks with them.

requires: Level 67+; the trace Time left behind
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire a stair is missing a step, Time's trace; step over it so cleanly the tower never records the step.
secret: You must have skipped an event you were destined to attend.
notice: [That moment never happened. Legendary class: Gap-Stepper of the Horizon.]
blurb: Follows Time down the narrow road of Skip, a small Void law that passes over a moment or a step, never used carelessly near Causality.
features: Skill: Passed Over
As a bonus action, teleport up to 30 feet; it does not count as movement and provokes nothing.
Skill: Missed Moment
Once per short rest, as a reaction, skip the moment an attack would hit you; it never happens.
Ultimate: Skip the Turn
Once per long rest, a creature within 60 feet skips its next two turns entirely (Wisdom save reduces it to one).
evolves: If you skip a death that Causality wrote for you, the class grants one skipped death per year.
cost: Each time you use Missed Moment, roll a d20; on a 1 you skip yourself an hour into the future.

requires: Level 67+; the trace Life left behind
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire lies a cairn of skulls from every beast; find Life's trace by asking each skull its name until one answers.
secret: You must keep the skull of the strongest thing you have killed.
notice: [Proof accepted. The dead keep count. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Life along the Skull, the part of Bones kept as proof of a kill whether or not it still holds power.
features: Skill: Proof of the Kill
Each skull you carry (maximum three) from your own kills grants resistance to that creature's damage and +1 to hit its kind.
Skill: Speaking Skull
Once per short rest, a skull you carry answers three questions about its life or its killer.
Ultimate: Crown of Skulls
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, your skulls orbit you, dealing 8d10 necrotic damage to enemies within 15 feet, and you may use one ability of the strongest.
evolves: If you carry the skull of a god's contractor, it can speak with that god for you.
cost: Undead treat you as hostile on sight.

requires: Level 100+; the trace Osttaur left behind
unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Osttaur's trace is a bed that has never been left; lie in it, and rise only when the tower itself forgets you are there.
secret: You must have ignored a direct summons from a god.
notice: [The will is dulled. Yours is the only one left. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Osttaur, the Silent Heart of Sloth, the Original Sin that dulls the will rather than the body.
features: Skill: Dull Will
Creatures within 60 feet make a Wisdom save at the start of each turn or lose their action; allies are immune.
Skill: Effortless
You make one attack per turn without using an action, and you never gain exhaustion.
Ultimate: The Long Torpor
Once per long rest, every creature within 1 mile that fails a Wisdom save falls into torpor for a day, unable to will anything.
evolves: If you outlast a god's patience, even immortals sleep in your torpor.
cost: You need sixteen hours of sleep a day and can never Dash.

requires: Level 56+; a piece of Ullear's remains
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Ullear's corpse sits at the end of a corridor that slows with every step; reach it before it decays, using only patience.
secret: You must have won a race by being slower.
notice: [Everything waits for you. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Ullear, the Twin-Faced Shade of Slowness, the paired opposite of Speed and the more often weaponised of the two.
features: Skill: Drag
Each hit halves the target's speed and removes its reactions until your next turn.
Skill: Late Strike
You act at the end of each round; your first attack each combat deals an extra 6d10 damage.
Ultimate: Everything Waits
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, enemies within 120 feet are slowed to one action and half speed; those below half hit points get no save.
evolves: If you outwait Speed's heir in a duel, Drag also slows spells cast near you.
cost: You always move at half speed.

requires: Level 45+; the trace Ulshaas left behind
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, Ulshaas left a keyhole too small for anything; shrink yourself through it.
secret: You must have saved a life by being overlooked.
notice: [Size reduced. Danger reduced. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Ulshaas, the Forgotten Shade of Smaller, the paired opposite of Bigger and the safer one to test on the living.
features: Skill: Shrink
As a bonus action, shrink yourself or a willing creature to Tiny for 10 minutes; Tiny creatures gain +2 AC.
Skill: Lesser
As an action, a creature within 60 feet shrinks one size per failed Constitution save (maximum two), halving its damage.
Ultimate: Speck
Once per long rest, shrink a creature to 1 inch for 1 minute (Constitution save negates); it loses all weapon attacks.
evolves: If you shrink a giant's wrath into something you can carry, the class learns to shrink spells as well.
cost: You are permanently one size smaller and carry half as much.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Nykath's remains
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Nykath's remains move with every reshuffle but always smell the same; find them five reshuffles in a row.
secret: You must have hunted only by smell for a full season.
notice: [The crudest sense, the surest kill. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Nykath, the Shrouded Shade of Smell, the least refined sense, kept by hunters rather than fighters.
features: Skill: Crude Nose
You smell fear, blood and rot within 120 feet and always know where hidden creatures are.
Skill: False Musk
You mask your scent and lay a false trail; beasts and trackers follow it instead.
Ultimate: Scent of Prey
Once per long rest, a creature you have smelled cannot hide from you for a week, and you deal an extra 4d10 damage to it.
evolves: If you hunt a beast of the Abyss by scent alone, you can smell lies.
cost: You reek of the wild; Charisma checks among townsfolk have disadvantage.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Nyroos left behind
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire waits an unsigned contract with a clause that only works sometimes; test it until it works, then sign Nyroos's name beside yours.
secret: You must have kept a promise that only applied under conditions that never came, until they did.
notice: [Condition met. This time. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Nyroos, the Quiet Shade of Sometime, the paired opposite of Always, a modifier whose conditions are still being worked out.
features: Skill: Under Conditions
Attach a condition to one feature each day (at night, in rain, while outnumbered); while it holds, that feature's numbers double.
Skill: Not This Time
Once per short rest, when an enemy effect targets you, roll a d6; on a 4 or higher it simply does not apply.
Ultimate: Sometime Is Now
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, every condition you have set counts as true.
evolves: If you meet Always's heir and both of you live, one of your conditions becomes permanent.
cost: Roll a d6 each dawn; on a 1, a random feature does not work that day.

requires: Level 1+; a piece of Time's remains
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire, Time's remains point to where rather than when; cross a room whose far wall keeps moving and touch it in one step.
secret: You must have been lost somewhere and found your way home without a map.
notice: [Where, not when. Legendary class: Corner-Folding Wanderer.]
blurb: Follows Time down the road of Spatial, the bending of where a thing is, which is exactly why it rarely pairs with Time Laws.
features: Skill: Bent Step
Once per short rest, as a bonus action, teleport up to 10 feet.
Skill: Folded Pocket
You carry a pocket of space 1 foot on each side that only you can reach into.
Ultimate: Fold the Room
Once per long rest, swap the positions of two creatures within 60 feet (Charisma save for the unwilling).
evolves: If you fold your way into a locked room in another realm, the Pocket grows large enough to hold a person.
cost: Your sense of time is broken; you never know the hour and are always late.

requires: Level 78+; a piece of Iron's remains
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Iron's last spear hangs where there is no up; throw it and catch it again with no sense of direction.
secret: You must have held a line alone with a spear against a charge.
notice: [Reach extended. The line holds. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Iron along the Spear, a cousin of Blade stretched long, closer to Dart in use than Axe in shape.
features: Skill: Long Shape
Your spear reach increases by 10 feet and your spear attacks deal an extra 6d10 piercing damage.
Skill: Dart Throw
Throw your spear up to 600 feet; it pierces every creature in its line and returns to your hand.
Ultimate: Impaling Line
Once per long rest, thrust a 1 mile line that deals 25d10 piercing damage to everything in it, ignoring the AC of mundane-grade armour.
evolves: If you free Iron, the spear can pin a Law in place for a day.
cost: You must always fight from the front; you cannot use cover.

requires: Level 1+; a piece of Life's remains
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire, a specter born from Life's remains repeats an unfinished task; finish it for them.
secret: You must have fulfilled someone's last wish after they died.
notice: [Unfinished business accepted. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Life along the Specter, bodiless like a Wraith but bound by unfinished business rather than a ritual, and never reliably commanded.
features: Skill: Bodiless Touch
Once per short rest, become partly incorporeal for 1 round and pass through creatures and objects.
Skill: Unfinished
While you have a declared unfinished goal, once per long rest you drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.
Ultimate: Haunting
Once per long rest, leave your body for 10 minutes as a specter and possess a creature (Charisma save).
evolves: If you finish a hundred unfinished tasks for the dead, they come to fight for you once.
cost: Each of your own unfinished tasks gives -1 to your saving throws.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Ostvaur's remains
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Ostvaur's remains guard a door that opens only to argument; talk it open.
secret: You must have talked an enemy out of killing you.
notice: [Objection sustained. Legendary class: Silver-Tongued Advocate.]
blurb: Follows Ostvaur, the Strange Shade of Speech, the raw ability every Verbal caster draws on, distinct from any single Word.
features: Skill: Raw Voice
Your spoken spells cannot be counterspelled, and you can speak with any creature that has a language.
Skill: Persuasive Edge
As a bonus action, a creature that hears you subtracts 1d8 from its next roll, or an ally adds 1d8.
Ultimate: Final Argument
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, creatures who hear you (Wisdom save) cannot attack you unless they first speak a better argument aloud.
evolves: If you argue a god into changing a contract, your voice can bind Minor contracts of your own.
cost: While unable to speak you lose all features and take 1d10 psychic damage each minute.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Zekaane's remains
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Zekaane's remains spin endlessly; stop them by spinning the other way at exactly the same speed.
secret: You must have spun in place until you collapsed, a hundred separate times.
notice: [Rotation added. The choir spins with you. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Zekaane, the Infinite Shape of Spin, one of the more abstract laws of the Void, adding rotation to anything it touches.
features: Skill: Add Rotation
Objects and projectiles you touch spin: thrown weapons deal an extra 2d8 damage and return to you.
Skill: Wild Turn
When you cast a spell, roll a d20; on a 1 to 5 a random spin effect is added, chosen by the DM.
Ultimate: Unwinding Gyre
Once per long rest, a 30 foot radius spins for 1 minute; creatures inside take 6d8 bludgeoning damage and are flung 20 feet each turn.
evolves: If you spin a star, the Gyre carries you between realms.
cost: You are always dizzy: disadvantage on Constitution saves to keep concentration.

requires: Level 1+; the trace Draniyr left behind
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire, Draniyr's trace is a drum you may strike only with breath; make it sound.
secret: You must have trained the same form every dawn for a year.
notice: [Reserve detected. The hearth is lit. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Draniyr, the Nameless Shade of Martial Spirit, the reserve a cultivator builds over years, owing nothing to the Spirit Realm.
features: Skill: Hearth Reserve
You gain points equal to your level; spend 1 to add 1d6 to a hit or move 10 feet extra.
Skill: Breath Under Fire
Spend 2 points to regain 2d6 plus your level in hit points.
Ultimate: Open the Hearth
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, your reserve doubles and your unarmed strikes deal an extra 2d6 force damage.
evolves: If you train for ten years without missing a dawn, your reserve fills on a short rest.
cost: Your reserve does not refill if you drink alcohol or skip a day of training.

requires: Level 1+; a piece of Iron's remains
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire, a dagger left by Iron splits light in two; strike the dummy so it shows two wounds from one stroke.
secret: You must have split a falling hair with a blade.
notice: [One strike, two wounds. Legendary class: Two-From-One Fencer.]
blurb: Follows Iron along the Split, a shape law that turns one strike into two, more at home on a dagger than anything heavier.
features: Skill: One Becomes Two
Once per turn, a dagger hit splits into a second strike for half damage.
Skill: Forked Feint
When both strikes hit, the target has disadvantage on its next attack.
Ultimate: Hundred Splits
Once per long rest, one dagger attack splits into eight strikes against creatures within 10 feet.
evolves: If you split an arrow in flight, the class can split spells into two weaker copies.
cost: Anything heavier than a shortsword feels wrong; you have disadvantage with it.

requires: Level 89+; the trace Sylph left behind
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Sylph's trace is a wind that tears everything apart; keep a single candle lit there for a full day.
secret: You must have stopped a fusion, curse or pact from collapsing and killing its holder.
notice: [Collapse halted. Hold steady. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Sylph through the Quiet Shade of Stabilise, the Law reached for when a Fusion, Curse or Pact begins to come apart.
features: Skill: Hold Together
Touch a creature: any curse, fusion or pact on it stops worsening, and if it is at 0 hit points it regains 10d10.
Skill: Steady Air
You and allies within 30 feet cannot be moved, knocked prone or transformed against your will.
Ultimate: Still Point
Once per long rest, for 1 hour within 1 mile, no effect worsens, no spell ends early and no creature drops below 1 hit point.
evolves: If you stabilise a dying god, it owes you a contract at 1st Finger.
cost: You can never land a killing blow; creatures you would kill stay at 1 hit point.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Cosmic left behind
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire rests a seed of packed light, Cosmic's trace; hold it until it starts to burn on its own in your hands.
secret: You must have stood under open sky every night for a year.
notice: [Ignition confirmed. You burn on your own now. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Cosmic down the road of the Star, a piece of Cosmic packed so tight it started to burn by itself.
features: Skill: Burning Core
You shed bright light for 30 feet; enemies in it take 3d10 radiant damage at the start of their turns.
Skill: Condensed Flare
As an action, a 60 foot cone of 12d10 radiant and fire damage; creatures that fail a Constitution save are blinded.
Ultimate: Ignition
Once per long rest, become a small star for 1 minute: you fly, enemies within 30 feet take 8d10 radiant damage each turn, and you are immune to cold.
evolves: If you burn through a night in the Void, Ignition lasts until you choose to dim.
cost: You glow always; you can never truly hide in darkness.

requires: Level 45+; a piece of Cosmic's remains
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, Cosmic's remains glimmer faintly under the crushing dark; gather that light into a jar with bare hands.
secret: You must have guided someone home by starlight alone.
notice: [Faint enough to hold. Legendary class: Gleaner of Faint Stars.]
blurb: Follows Cosmic along Starlight, a distant cousin of Plasma, carrying Cosmic essence faint enough for mortals to touch.
features: Skill: Touchable Light
Shape starlight into a blade (an extra 3d8 radiant damage) or a shield (+1 AC).
Skill: Guiding Glimmer
Allies within your light treat Realm Pressure as 2 lower.
Ultimate: Pour Out the Sky
Once per long rest, empty the jar: a 60 foot radius of 12d8 radiant damage, and allies inside heal half that amount.
evolves: If you refill the jar at the top of every Tower, the light can blind a god.
cost: The jar must be refilled under open sky each week, or your features fade.

requires: Level 89+; the trace Ostluune left behind
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Ostluune's trace hisses in every ear; find the silence inside the hiss and stay in it.
secret: You must have ruined an enemy's message so thoroughly that it was never understood.
notice: [Message lost. Noise accepted. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Ostluune, the Strange Shade of Static, the paired opposite of Signal: noise where a message was supposed to be.
features: Skill: Noise Field
Within 120 feet, telepathy, sending and shouted commands fail, and enemies cannot use the Help action or share bonuses.
Skill: Garble
As a reaction, turn an enemy's incantation into noise; the spell fails (Charisma check against its level).
Ultimate: White Hiss
Once per long rest, for 1 minute within 1 mile, all spells, signals and contracts are cut; gods cannot reach their contractors.
evolves: If you jam a god's voice for a full day, Static can erase one memory from any listener.
cost: You cannot receive messages or telepathy, and half of all allied buffs fail on you.

n: Tempered Heir of the Locked Forge
requires: Level 56+; the trace Iron left behind
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire burns a forge whose fire is Iron's trace; temper your own armour in it ring by ring until it becomes steel.
secret: You must have quenched a blade in your own blood.
notice: [Iron evolved. Legendary class: Tempered Heir of the Locked Forge.]
blurb: Follows Iron through Steel, the evolved metal made after Iron was locked away in the Spirit Realm.
features: Skill: Evolved Metal
Metal armour you wear counts as one grade higher, and you gain +2 AC.
Skill: Living Plate
While above half hit points, you regain 4d10 hit points at the start of each of your turns.
Ultimate: Unlocked Alloy
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, your armour becomes Inner Realm grade: immune to nonmagical weapon damage, and your attacks deal an extra 6d10.
evolves: If you free Iron, your steel becomes the first armour of a new grade.
cost: Your armour fuses to you a little more each year and can never be removed.

requires: Level 67+; the trace Seltheur left behind
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Seltheur's trace is a plain of Realm Pressure 9; stand there without fainting until the strange stars turn once.
secret: You must have fought for three days without rest.
notice: [Load accepted. The body answers. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Seltheur, the Unknown Shade of Stress, the body's answer to the Mortal Realm's pressure rather than the mind's.
features: Skill: Body Under Load
For each point of Realm Pressure above your Attunement, you deal an extra 1d10 damage instead of suffering strain.
Skill: Fight or Fall
While below half hit points you make an extra attack each turn and have resistance to all damage.
Ultimate: Snapping Point
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you cannot drop below 1 hit point and your attacks deal an extra 6d10; afterward you gain two levels of exhaustion.
evolves: If you survive Realm Pressure 9 at Attunement 0, the class ignores all pressure forever.
cost: A long rest without having fought first gives you no benefit.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Zetheane left behind
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire one voice too many is singing, Zetheane's test; take it away without silencing anyone.
secret: You must have given away half of everything you own.
notice: [Value decreased. Legendary class: Minus-Hand Arbiter.]
blurb: Follows Zetheane, the Twin-Faced Shade of Subtract, the Void law of plain decrease without Destruction's violence.
features: Skill: Plain Decrease
Each hit reduces the target's next roll by 1d8.
Skill: Take Away
As an action, subtract from a creature for 1 minute: 2 AC, half its speed, or 3d10 from all its damage.
Ultimate: Less Than Zero
Once per long rest, remove one feature or spell from a creature for 1 minute (Charisma save).
evolves: If you subtract a whole army to nothing without a death, the class can remove a curse permanently.
cost: You can never gain extra: temporary hit points and buffs on you are halved.

requires: Level 12+; a piece of Sylph's remains
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire the mist bends one way, Sylph's remains passing; follow it to the place it first bent and breathe it in.
secret: You must have walked wherever the grass bent for a full week.
notice: [A voice, a pressure, a direction. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Sylph, Progenitor of Air, the only progenitor who never stayed still long enough to be drawn.
features: Skill: Voice on the Wind
Your voice carries 1 mile, you cannot be grappled, and once per short rest you gain a 30 foot flying speed for 1 minute.
Skill: Pressure Drop
As an action, a 30 foot cone of 4d10 bludgeoning damage pushes creatures 20 feet.
Ultimate: Never Drawn
Once per long rest, become moving air for 1 minute: invisible, flying 90 feet, and resistant to all damage.
evolves: If one of Sylph's children accepts you, you can call that wind once per day.
cost: If you do not move at least 30 feet on your turn, you have disadvantage on attacks.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Thalvael's remains
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Thalvael's remains are two trees grown from one root; tend them until both bloom on the same day.
secret: You must have shared your blood with a beast to save its life.
notice: [Two lives, one root. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Thalvael, the Forgotten Shade of Symbiosis, a Nature Law binding two lives for mutual benefit, gentler than any Pact.
features: Skill: Bound Lives
Bind with one beast or ally; whenever either of you hits, the other regains 2d8 hit points.
Skill: Mutual Benefit
You and your partner share all resistances and senses.
Ultimate: Two Become One Life
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you and your partner may act on each other's turns, and both regain 4d10 hit points each turn.
evolves: If the bond lasts ten years, your partner gains a class of its own.
cost: If your partner dies, you drop to 0 hit points.

requires: Level 12+; a piece of Balance's remains
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Balance's remains are reflected in half-mirrors; make the reflection and the real match perfectly.
secret: You must have made two identical things entirely by hand.
notice: [Shape balanced. Legendary class: Mirror-Balanced Smith.]
blurb: Follows Balance along Symmetry, balance in shape rather than in measure, opposed by Asymmetry.
features: Skill: Even Shape
Your perfectly balanced armour grants +1 AC, and you cannot be flanked.
Skill: Mirror Answer
Once per short rest, as a reaction when hit, the attacker takes the same damage.
Ultimate: Perfect Symmetry
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, all damage you deal to one creature is dealt equally to a second creature you choose within 60 feet.
evolves: If you forge a matched pair for two rivals, the class can mirror a spell back at its caster.
cost: Losing one item of a pair gives you disadvantage on everything until it is replaced.

requires: Level 100+; the trace Drazen left behind
unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Drazen's trace is an empty plinth; take what sits on it even though it holds nothing.
secret: You must have taken something from a god.
notice: [Taken. It is yours now. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Drazen, the Strange Shade of Take, the paired opposite of Gift and by far the more common of the two.
features: Skill: First Grab
As a bonus action, take a held object, a spell effect or a buff from a creature within 60 feet.
Skill: Full Ownership
Anything you take becomes yours completely, attuned instantly.
Ultimate: Take Everything
Once per long rest, take one Rune-granted ability, contract or class from a creature for a day (Charisma save).
evolves: If you take a Rune directly from its holder, the class becomes a vault for it.
cost: You can never give; any gift you offer turns to dust.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Varios left behind
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Varios left a wild beast living in the rings; ride it with no whip, chain or spell.
secret: You must have raised a predator from birth.
notice: [Will bound gently. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Varios, the Nameless Shade of Tame, binding an Animal or Beastman to another's will without going as far as Imprison.
features: Skill: Gentle Bind
A beast or beastman of challenge rating up to half your level obeys you until released (Wisdom save).
Skill: Pack Under Will
Your tamed creatures gain +1 AC and extra hit points equal to twice your level.
Ultimate: Call of the Bridle
Once per long rest, every beast within 1 mile answers your call for 1 hour.
evolves: If you tame a beast of the Abyss, Gentle Bind also works on summons.
cost: You take a quarter of all damage your tamed creatures take.

requires: Level 56+; a piece of Veskan's remains
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Veskan's remains steep in a cup; drink it and name every Law dissolved inside.
secret: You must have survived deliberately tasting poison.
notice: [Flavour identified. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Veskan, the Shrouded Shade of Taste, one of the five senses a Martial cultivator refines past its mortal limit.
features: Skill: Refined Palate
Taste a material to know its grade, Potency and origin; you are immune to poison.
Skill: Taste of Power
When you taste a creature's blood, you learn its resistances and its next action.
Ultimate: Devour the Law
Once per long rest, taste a spell as it hits you: it has no effect and you may cast it back.
evolves: If you taste every grade of material, you can tell a lie from a truth by its flavour.
cost: Ordinary food is ash; you must eat Inner Realm grade material each week.

requires: Level 1+; a piece of Thalshayr's remains
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire, Thalshayr's remains are a stopped clockwork; repair it without any magic.
secret: You must have built a working machine that uses no Law at all.
notice: [No Law required. Legendary class: Lawless Tinker.]
blurb: Follows Thalshayr, the Twin-Faced Shade of Technology, the name for Man Made things that work without any Law.
features: Skill: Gadgeteer
In 1 hour you build a simple gadget (a lockpick, a lamp, a +1 crossbow) that works even where magic fails.
Skill: Gearwork Helper
You build a small clockwork companion that can carry, scout and hand you items.
Ultimate: Lawless Engine
Once per long rest, a machine you built ignores all magic for 1 minute and deals 4d10 force damage each turn.
evolves: If your machine beats a spell in a fair contest, the class works at Mysterious grade.
cost: Magic items attuned to you work at half strength.

requires: Level 78+; a piece of Selzeael's remains
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Selzeael's remains wait in a hall where sound dies; reach them by thinking the way.
secret: You must have gone a full year without speaking aloud.
notice: [Mind to mind. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Selzeael, the Hidden Shade of Telepathy, a Mental Law that skips Speech and Word entirely.
features: Skill: Wordless Reach
You speak telepathically with any creature within 10 miles and read its surface thoughts.
Skill: Mind Spike
As an action, deal 12d10 psychic damage; a creature that fails an Intelligence save is stunned.
Ultimate: Chorus of Minds
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, link up to 100 minds; linked allies share senses and may act on each other's turns.
evolves: If you reach a god's mind, you can carry a contract between mortals.
cost: You hear everything; you cannot finish a long rest within a mile of a crowd.

requires: Level 12+; the trace Eirraor left behind
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Eirraor's trace is a heartbeat in the mist; climb in step with it without missing a beat.
secret: You must have danced or drummed for a full night without stopping.
notice: [Rhythm matched. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Eirraor, the Nameless Shade of Tempo, the rhythm a fighter or musician keeps, felt rather than counted.
features: Skill: Felt Rhythm
After hitting the same creature twice in a row, your third hit deals an extra 2d10.
Skill: Off-Beat
Once per combat, move your place in initiative earlier or later.
Ultimate: Crescendo
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, each consecutive hit adds a cumulative 1d10 damage.
evolves: If you keep a rhythm through a whole siege, allies can share your Crescendo.
cost: When you miss, you lose your rhythm and take 1d10 psychic damage.

requires: Level 1+; the trace Gnome left behind
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire, Gnome's trace is a barren plot; turn it into a working field within a week.
secret: You must have dug a well or drained a marsh by hand.
notice: [The land was decided. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Gnome along Terraformation, reshaping land at scale so it looks natural even though something decided it.
features: Skill: Reshape Ground
As an action, change a 10 foot cube of terrain: raise, lower, drain or soften it.
Skill: Decided Land
Allies standing on ground you shaped gain +1 AC.
Ultimate: Remake the Place
Once per long rest, a 100 foot radius becomes a different terrain permanently.
evolves: If you turn a desert into farmland, Gnome's children treat you as one of their own.
cost: You cannot take from the land without returning something; doing so gives disadvantage for a day.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Rymias's remains
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Rymias's remains hold one note of the endless choir; steal that note without the song noticing.
secret: You must have stolen a spell from a caster.
notice: [Law lifted. Legendary class: Pickpocket of Halos.]
blurb: Follows Rymias, the Hidden Shade of Theft, a cousin of Take aimed at stealing a Law itself.
features: Skill: Lift a Law
On a hit, steal one active buff or spell from the target; it now benefits you.
Skill: Light Fingers
As a bonus action, steal an item from a creature, even mid-fight.
Ultimate: Steal the Song
Once per long rest, take a creature's class feature for 1 hour (Charisma save).
evolves: If you steal from a god without being caught, the class can lift a Rune for a day.
cost: Gods distrust thieves; you can never hold a contract above Minor.

requires: Level 34+; the trace Osttaur left behind
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Osttaur's trace is a crack between two floors; slip through it before the tower reshuffles.
secret: You must have escaped a prison through a gap no one thought was large enough.
notice: [Width reduced. You fit. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Osttaur down Thinner, the paired opposite of Wider, favoured for anything that must slip through.
features: Skill: Slip
You move through any gap 1 inch wide and cannot be grappled.
Skill: Paper Edge
Your blade is thinned to nothing: attacks ignore 2 points of AC and deal an extra 4d10.
Ultimate: Thin as a Line
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, become flat; attacks from the side miss you automatically.
evolves: If you slip through a god's ward, the class can thin walls between realms.
cost: Your maximum hit points are reduced by your level.

requires: Level 45+; the trace Time left behind
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, Time's trace is a clock that runs backward as you descend; arrive at the exact moment you entered.
secret: You must have kept a record of every hour of your life for a full year.
notice: [Passage measured. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Time, the Silent Shape of Time, formed when the Void folded until it could measure its own passing.
features: Skill: Measured Pace
You have advantage on initiative, and once per short rest you take an extra action.
Skill: Fold Back
As a reaction, rewind your own hit points and position to the start of the round.
Ultimate: Stop the Count
Once per long rest, time stops for everyone else for 3 rounds.
evolves: If you measure a moment Causality forgot, Stop the Count can be used twice.
cost: You age twice as fast.

requires: Level 1+; a piece of Time's remains
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire, Time's remains are sand that never runs out; turn the hourglass at the exact moment it empties.
secret: You must have kept a vigil for its full appointed length.
notice: [Duration measured. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Time down Time Duration, measuring only how long something lasts rather than bending its pace.
features: Skill: Extend
Once per short rest, a spell or effect you or an ally creates lasts twice as long.
Skill: Shorten Harm
Conditions on allies within 30 feet last half as long.
Ultimate: Lasting Moment
Once per long rest, one effect lasts until your next long rest regardless of its duration.
evolves: If you outlast a curse meant to be eternal, you can measure lifespans.
cost: Conditions on you last 1 round longer.

requires: Level 45+; the trace Eirnois left behind
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, Eirnois's trace lies in the darkest pressure; find it by touch alone, then feel nothing as it crushes you.
secret: You must have endured a branding without flinching.
notice: [Touch refined. Pain removed. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Eirnois, the Quiet Shade of Touch, the sense cultivators refine last, since numbing it serves better in a fight.
features: Skill: Numbed
You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, and pain effects do nothing to you.
Skill: Reading Touch
While grappling, you sense the target's hit points and next action, and score critical hits on 18 to 20.
Ultimate: Feel Nothing
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you ignore all damage; when it ends you take half of it.
evolves: If you feel a progenitor's remains with bare hands, the class can sense Laws by touch.
cost: You cannot feel your wounds; the DM tracks your hit points in secret.

requires: Level 67+; the trace Liozeune left behind
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Liozeune left a ritual no one remembers the reason for; perform it perfectly.
secret: You must have kept a custom for ten years without knowing why.
notice: [Custom upheld. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Liozeune, the Quiet Shade of Tradition, what Culture becomes once it outlives anyone remembering why.
features: Skill: Old Ways
Once per short rest, perform a rite: allies have advantage on saves for 1 hour.
Skill: Lore of Forebears
You know the history of any place or object you touch.
Ultimate: Unbroken Custom
Once per long rest, all creatures within 1 mile must obey a custom you name, such as no blood on holy ground, for a day.
evolves: If you revive a dead tradition across a realm, its gods take notice of you.
cost: New tools and new ways fail in your hands.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Liolun left behind
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Liolun's trace is a training post worn to a sliver; strike it ten thousand times.
secret: You must have trained a skill you had no talent for until you mastered it.
notice: [Repetition recorded. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Liolun, the Nameless Shade of Training, the deliberate practice behind Learning and Aptitude.
features: Skill: Repetition Engraved
Each time you use the same skill one hundred times, it gains a permanent +1.
Skill: Drill Instructor
Allies who train with you for a week gain +1 to one skill.
Ultimate: Ten Thousand Repetitions
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, every attack you make with your most practised weapon automatically hits.
evolves: If your student surpasses you, you both gain one engraved skill.
cost: You cannot gain bonuses from magic items or feats granted by magic.

requires: Level 56+; a piece of Ishraar's remains
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Ishraar's remains are a node; send a spell through it all the way to the first floor.
secret: You must have delivered a spell someone else cast.
notice: [Effect sent. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Ishraar, the Strange Shade of Transmission, a cousin of Telepathy that sends a Law's effect rather than a thought.
features: Skill: Send Effect
You can cast touch spells at a range of 1 mile.
Skill: Relay
As a reaction, redirect a spell targeting an ally to a new target.
Ultimate: Broadcast
Once per long rest, a spell you cast affects every chosen creature you know within 10 miles.
evolves: If you relay a god's blessing, you can send contracts.
cost: Enemies sense your location whenever you Relay.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Braleur left behind
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Braleur's trace is a crucible; turn lead into the tree's own wood.
secret: You must have transmuted your own blood.
notice: [Substance changed. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Braleur, the Hidden Keeper of Transmutation, the heart of Alchemy that turns one substance into another.
features: Skill: True Change
Change one cubic foot of material into another of the same grade.
Skill: Unmaking Touch
As an action, transmute a creature's flesh for 10d10 damage; on a failed Constitution save it is restrained as stone.
Ultimate: Great Work
Once per long rest, change one object or creature permanently into another (Constitution save).
evolves: If you transmute a material up a grade, you can change Potency itself.
cost: Each Great Work turns a part of your own body to some other material.

requires: Level 67+; the trace Lionoane left behind
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Lionoane's test is a duel against your own record; win it fairly.
secret: You must have ended a war by single combat.
notice: [Contest settled. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Lionoane, the Hidden Shade of Trial, the Law behind any contest meant to settle something.
features: Skill: Call to Trial
Challenge a creature to a duel with terms; outsiders who interfere take 6d10 radiant damage.
Skill: Verdict
The winner of a trial you oversee gains a boon; the loser must obey the terms.
Ultimate: Trial by Realm
Once per long rest, decide an entire battle by one contest; both sides are bound by its result.
evolves: If you settle a dispute between gods, the class grants you a seat at their judgements.
cost: You can never refuse a challenge.

requires: Level 45+; the trace Quorath left behind
unlock: Descend the Sunken Spire blindfolded, led only by a stranger; Quorath's trace waits for those who reach the bottom this way.
secret: You must never have betrayed anyone.
notice: [Bond laid. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Quorath, the Smiling Heart of Trust, a splinter of Light laid between two people, undone entirely by Betrayal.
features: Skill: Laid Between
Bond with up to five allies; you share senses and each gains +1 AC.
Skill: Trusted Shield
When a bonded ally is hit, you may take the damage instead.
Ultimate: Unbroken Faith
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, bonded allies cannot fail saving throws.
evolves: If a betrayer earns your trust again, the bond can include enemies.
cost: If you are betrayed, you lose the class until you forgive the betrayer.

requires: Level 78+; a piece of Ortheeth's remains
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Ortheeth's remains rotate forever with no up or down; turn with them until you find up.
secret: You must have danced a full night without leaving a single spot.
notice: [Rotation in place. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Ortheeth, the Twin-Faced Shade of Turn, rotating something in place, gentler than Spin.
features: Skill: Rotate
As a reaction, turn an incoming attack aside and redirect it at another creature within reach.
Skill: Turn in Place
As an action, spin a creature around; it loses its reactions and attacks against it have advantage.
Ultimate: About-Face of the World
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, rotate gravity in a 120 foot radius any way you choose.
evolves: If you turn a god's back to you, the class can turn spells.
cost: You cannot move in straight lines; you can never Dash.

requires: Level 45+; a piece of Kamiune's remains
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, Kamiune's remains are wrung like a rag; untwist them with your hands alone.
secret: You must have broken your own bone and kept fighting.
notice: [Torque applied. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Kamiune, the Quiet Shade of Twist, a sharper cousin of Turn used to break rather than reposition.
features: Skill: Wrenching Grip
While grappling, twist for 6d10 damage; one limb of the target becomes unusable.
Skill: Torque
Heavy weapon attacks deal an extra 4d10 damage and ignore resistance.
Ultimate: Wring Out
Once per long rest, twist a creature for 20d10 damage (Constitution save halves).
evolves: If you wring a curse out of an ally, the class can break spells.
cost: Each use of Wring Out deals 2d10 damage to you.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Vessaael left behind
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Vessaael's trace is a plaque bearing a debt not yet decided; bet on its outcome.
secret: You must have staked your life on a coin flip.
notice: [Outcome undecided. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Vessaael, the Hidden Shade of Uncertain, a Law that works only where the outcome is genuinely undecided.
features: Skill: Undecided Edge
When advantage and disadvantage cancel, you choose the result of the roll.
Skill: Probability Fray
Once per short rest, reroll any d20 within 30 feet.
Ultimate: Collapse the Odds
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, any uncertain roll within 60 feet resolves in your favour.
evolves: If you win a bet with a god, the class can make one certainty uncertain again.
cost: Your features fail against surprised or helpless creatures; their fate is already decided.

requires: Level 89+; the trace Selmiix left behind
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Selmiix's test is to raise each undead type in order, from Skeleton upward, though each floor forgets the last.
secret: You must have preserved a corpse for a full year.
notice: [Ladder climbed. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Selmiix, the Shrouded Shade of Undead Summoning, who ranked the undead by how much power their corpses kept.
features: Skill: Ladder of the Dead
Raise any undead type up to Wraith; fresher corpses keep half again as much power.
Skill: Preservation
Corpses you touch stop decaying, and undead you raise keep one class feature.
Ultimate: Climb the Ladder
Once per long rest, raise a Lich-grade servant from a powerful corpse for 1 hour.
evolves: If you raise a Grim Reaper, it serves you for one task.
cost: Healing on you restores only half.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Undine's remains
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Undine's remains take a new shape with every reshuffle; hold them in cupped hands through one full shift.
secret: You must have nearly drowned and chosen not to fear water after.
notice: [Formless and restless. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Undine, Progenitor of Water, formless and restless, never the same shape twice.
features: Skill: Restless Current
After each attack, move 15 feet without provoking.
Skill: Drowning Embrace
While grappling, fill the target's lungs: 6d10 damage and it cannot speak.
Ultimate: Flood of Every Shape
Once per long rest, release a 60 foot wave for 12d10 bludgeoning damage that reshapes the terrain.
evolves: If you gather a second piece of Undine, your wave can carry allies across a realm.
cost: In dry places you have disadvantage on all checks.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Sellueth's remains
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Sellueth's remains sit in a room with no rules written; survive by guessing them.
secret: You must have admitted to a god, truthfully, that you do not know something.
notice: [Class: ???. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Sellueth, the Unknown Shade of Unknown, the honest answer for whatever has not been placed yet, maybe even The Beyond.
features: Skill: Unclassified
You cannot be identified, scried or divined; your class shows only as ???.
Skill: Unknown Answer
Once per short rest, roll on a DM table for a random effect of level-appropriate power.
Ultimate: Touch the Beyond
Once per long rest, the DM chooses a powerful effect from beyond the known realms.
evolves: If you learn what the Beyond actually is, the class gains a name.
cost: Divination and identification also fail for you.

requires: Level 67+; a piece of Brasayr's remains
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Brasayr's remains are a tapestry; unpick it thread by thread without tearing a single one.
secret: You must have dismantled a ward without triggering it.
notice: [Weave undone. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Brasayr, the Forgotten Shade of Unravel, the paired opposite of Weave, undoing combined spells into pieces.
features: Skill: Loose Thread
As an action, end a spell, or split a combined spell and dispel one part.
Skill: Fraying Hit
Each hit removes one buff from the target.
Ultimate: Unweave
Once per long rest, all magic effects you choose within 120 feet unravel.
evolves: If you unravel a god's ward, the class can undo a contract.
cost: Your own concentration spells last half as long.

n: Crimson Guest of the Shuffled Halls
requires: Level 34+; a piece of Zetheth's remains
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Zetheth's remains lie in a coffin; drink the last blood left inside.
secret: You must have willingly given your blood to a stranger.
notice: [Blood accepted. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Zetheth, the Forgotten Shade of Vampire, the Undead Summoning that feeds on Blood instead of borrowed Life.
features: Skill: Blood Feed
When you bite a creature, you regain hit points equal to the damage dealt.
Skill: Night Grace
At night you have +10 feet speed and resistance to nonmagical damage.
Ultimate: Crimson Feast
Once per long rest, drain all creatures within 30 feet for 8d10 necrotic damage, healing half of the total.
evolves: If you drink from a god's contractor, you take one of their abilities for a day.
cost: Sunlight burns you for 2d10 radiant damage per turn.

requires: Level 67+; the trace Zesaune left behind
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Zesaune's trace is an echo that never ends; finish its sentence.
secret: You must have won a duel casting with voice alone.
notice: [Spoken and done. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Zesaune, the Unknown Shade of Verbal, casting through Speech, faster than gesture but useless in silence.
features: Skill: Word-Cast
Your spells need only verbal components, and you may cast one as a bonus action.
Skill: Echoing Verse
Allies who hear you may repeat your spell once at half power.
Ultimate: Spoken World
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, your spoken spells have double range and effect.
evolves: If you speak a spell no one taught you, the class learns it permanently.
cost: You cannot cast silently or with gesture; subtle casting fails for you.

requires: Level 12+; the trace Sylph left behind
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire the mist turns in a spiral; walk to its eye, where Sylph's trace merged with Spin.
secret: You must have survived a whirlwind.
notice: [Fusion unstable. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Sylph through Vortex, the unstable fusion of Air and Spin that birthed Boreas, Zephyrus, Notus and Eurus.
features: Skill: Whirl Shroud
Ranged attacks against you have disadvantage.
Skill: Gust Pull
As an action, pull a creature 20 feet toward you and deal 3d10 bludgeoning damage.
Ultimate: Unstable Fusion
Once per long rest, a 20 foot vortex follows you for 1 minute, dealing 4d10 damage each turn.
evolves: If two of the four winds accept you, the vortex can carry you between floors of any Tower.
cost: When you roll a 1 on a d20, you are flung 30 feet in a random direction.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Iron left behind
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Iron's trace is a gate wall; hold it shut against the debt collectors for a full day.
secret: You must have defended a gate alone.
notice: [Stop, not travel. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Iron through Wall, a defensive shape wider than Line and meant to stop.
features: Skill: Raise Rampart
Once per short rest, raise a 30 foot wall of iron for 1 minute.
Skill: Stop, Not Travel
You cannot be moved, and enemies that enter your reach must stop.
Ultimate: Unpassable
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, raise a 120 foot circle of iron wall.
evolves: If you free Iron, your walls become permanent fortresses.
cost: On a turn you raise a wall, you cannot move more than 10 feet.

requires: Level 100+; the trace Gnome left behind
unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Gnome's trace is a wasteland; live in it for a full year.
secret: You must have let your own land rot.
notice: [Land claimed by decay. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Gnome through Waste, land left to rot the way Swamp is mud left to rot, claimed partly by Decay.
features: Skill: Rot Land
Ground within 60 feet becomes waste: enemies take 15d10 necrotic damage each turn.
Skill: Spore Cloud
As an action, release spores in 30 feet; creatures are poisoned for 1 minute and take 30d10 necrotic damage.
Ultimate: Wasteland
Once per long rest, a 10 mile region becomes waste for a day; only allies can live in it.
evolves: If you restore the waste you made, Gnome himself acknowledges you.
cost: Plants die within 30 feet of you.

requires: Level 67+; a piece of Vamieth's remains
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Vamieth's remains are an empty ribcage the size of a hut; sit inside it and fast for seven days while the strange stars wheel overhead, then eat the one thing it offers you.
secret: You must have survived a famine without eating another person, so that the hunger has never yet been fed.
notice: [Hunger registered. It will grow. Legendary class: Hollow-Bellied Stalker.]
blurb: Follows Vamieth, the Shrouded Shade of Wendigo, weak as a Ghoul at first but stronger with every Life it takes from the living, like the frost-hungry spirits of the deep winter woods.
features: Skill: Growing Hunger
Each creature of your level or higher you consume permanently raises your maximum hit points by 5, up to five times your level.
Skill: Famine's Touch
Your hits deal an extra 6d10 necrotic damage, and the target cannot regain hit points until your next turn.
Ultimate: The Endless Meal
Once per long rest, devour a creature within 5 feet that is below a quarter of its hit points: it dies, and you regain all your hit points and one spent resource.
evolves: If you go a full year without feeding and still keep your strength, the hunger turns on Famine itself and you can starve a curse.
cost: You must eat living flesh once a week or gain a level of exhaustion that no rest removes.

requires: Level 89+; the trace Undine left behind
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire the floor is always wet though no water falls; Undine's trace hides in the damp, and you must stay soaked from the first floor to the last without once drying off.
secret: You must have gone a full year without ever being completely dry.
notice: [Saturated. Nothing here will burn. Legendary class awakened.]
