blurb: Follows Undine through Wet, the paired opposite of Dry, a passing cousin of Water that clings rather than flows, like the drowned folk who walk out of rivers still dripping.
features: Skill: Soak
Everything within 60 feet of you is drenched: fire effects fail, and lightning damage against soaked enemies is doubled.
Skill: Slick
Creatures that move on soaked ground make a Dexterity save or fall prone and lose the rest of their movement.
Ultimate: Drown the Dry
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, a 1 mile area is flooded knee deep; enemies are restrained on a failed Strength save each turn and take 8d10 cold damage.
evolves: If you soak the First Spire's burning wind, Water's Law answers your call once.
cost: You can never use or carry fire, and in dry places you have disadvantage on Constitution saves.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Orraiel left behind
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire hangs one plaque scrubbed perfectly white, Orraiel's trace; sit before it for a full day and write nothing, while every debt in the tower demands to be recorded.
secret: You must have worn only undyed white for a full year, even through battle.
notice: [No record found. Legendary class: Blank-Page Pilgrim.]
blurb: Follows Orraiel, the Nameless Shade of White, paired with Black more by habit than by any true tie to Light or Dark: the blank page before anything is written.
features: Skill: Blank Face
Creatures forget your face and name within 1 minute of losing sight of you, unless you choose otherwise.
Skill: Whiteout
As an action, creatures within 30 feet make a Constitution save or are blinded until the end of your next turn.
Ultimate: Clean Slate
Once per long rest, erase one record, debt or memory of a single event from every mind and page within 1 mile.
evolves: If you erase a debt from the Ledger Spire itself, the class can wipe a curse from its bearer.
cost: No song or record of your deeds survives; you are never remembered as a hero.

requires: Level 56+; a piece of Vataix's remains
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Vataix's remains lie between two growth rings a hundred feet apart; stretch your arms until you touch both at once.
secret: You must have defended two places at the same time and lost neither.
notice: [Spread confirmed. Hold both. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Vataix, the Forgotten Shade of Wider, the paired opposite of Thinner, widening a shape's spread rather than its length.
features: Skill: Broaden
The areas of your spells and the reach of your weapon attacks double.
Skill: Wide Stance
You cannot be knocked prone, and enemies cannot move past you within 15 feet without your leave.
Ultimate: Span the Horizon
Once per long rest, one weapon attack strikes every enemy you choose within 120 feet.
evolves: If you shelter a whole town with your arms through a disaster, Broaden extends to realm scale for a day.
cost: Narrow places choke you; you have disadvantage on everything indoors or underground.

requires: Level 45+; a piece of Infinatas's remains
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, Infinatas's remains are a wishing well with no water; drop your most precious possession into it and do not wish for anything.
secret: You must never once have spoken a wish aloud.
notice: [Wish received. Answer unknown. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Infinatas, the Hidden Shade of Wish, the rarest and least reliable Law on record, answering no realm at all.
features: Skill: Small Wishes
Once per day, produce the effect of any spell of 5th level or lower without a slot.
Skill: Unreliable Grant
Once per short rest, turn a failed roll into a success; on a d20 roll of 1 the wish twists against you instead.
Ultimate: The Well Answers
Once per long rest, wish for any spell effect of 8th level or lower; afterward roll a d6, and on a 1 the class sleeps for a week.
evolves: If you ever wish for nothing at all, the Well grants one true wish of the DM's choosing.
cost: Each wish costs a cherished memory, chosen by the DM.

requires: Level 78+; a piece of Aelkaiel's remains
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Aelkaiel's corpse cradles a globe of the Mortal Realm; carry it down all 78 floors without your own light, air or sense of up, and never drop it.
secret: You must have walked from one edge of the Mortal Realm to the other.
notice: [World shouldered. Legendary class: Atlas of the Mortal Shape.]
blurb: Follows Aelkaiel, the Twin-Faced Shade of World, bigger than Nature: the whole physical shape of the Mortal Realm, like the titan who held up the sky.
features: Skill: Feel the World
You sense every quake, march and change of land within 10 miles.
Skill: Shift the Land
As an action, raise or sink ground in a 100 foot radius by up to 100 feet; creatures caught take 10d10 bludgeoning damage.
Ultimate: The World Turns
Once per long rest, reshape the geography within 10 miles: move rivers, raise ridges, open valleys.
evolves: If you rebuild a land a disaster erased, the Mortal Realm itself grants you a second Ultimate use.
cost: You carry the weight of everything; your walking speed is halved and you can never fly.

requires: Level 89+; the trace Ishleos left behind
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire stands an altar to a god no one remembers, Ishleos's trace; pray there until something answers, even though you forget each prayer as you finish it.
secret: You must have worshipped a forgotten god for a full year with no reward.
notice: [Faith sustained. A god remembers you. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Ishleos, the Unknown Shade of Worship, the mortal act that keeps a god's power from thinning the way Light and Dark already have.
features: Skill: Sustaining Prayer
Any god you worship counts you as a contractor one rank higher, up to 1st Finger.
Skill: Altar of Many
Allies who pray with you on a short rest gain resistance to one damage type of your god's choosing until their next long rest.
Ultimate: Rekindle the Divine
Once per long rest, restore a fading or weakened god to full power for 1 hour; it grants you one miracle in return.
evolves: If you bring a dead god back to worship, it becomes your patron at 1st Finger rank.
cost: If you miss a day of worship, every contract you hold falls silent for a week.

requires: Level 78+; the trace Life left behind
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Life's trace drifts as a fragment of spirit with no corpse to hold it; catch it in the silence and bind it without any body at all.
secret: You must have spoken with the spirit of someone who died before you were born.
notice: [Fragment bound. No corpse required. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Life through Wraith, summoned from a sliver of spirit rather than a corpse, frail in body but the first undead to keep a scrap of magic.
features: Skill: Bodiless Servants
Summon up to three wraiths from spirit fragments; each can cast one spell of 5th level or lower that its original knew.
Skill: Spirit Sliver
Your wraiths pass through walls and are immune to nonmagical damage, and you can see through their eyes.
Ultimate: Host of Fragments
Once per long rest, summon a host of twenty wraiths for 1 hour, each dealing 6d10 necrotic damage with a touch.
evolves: If you bind a fragment of a hero's spirit, its wraith keeps that hero's full spellcasting.
cost: Your own body thins; your Strength score is reduced by 2.

requires: Level 100+; the trace Nyleas left behind
unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Nyleas's trace is half of a burning circle; complete it with your own body at the moment the tower's false sun stands highest.
secret: You must have saved a life at noon, with the sun directly above you.
notice: [Half of the whole. The light is yours. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Nyleas, the Unknown Shade of Yang, the other half of Yin and just as reliant on its opposite to mean anything.
features: Skill: Sun Palm
Your unarmed strikes deal an extra 10d10 radiant damage, and you are immune to blindness.
Skill: Seek the Other Half
While an ally holding a Yin class is within 60 feet, you both gain an extra action each turn.
Ultimate: High Noon
Once per long rest, release a blast of noon light in a 1 mile radius: 30d10 radiant damage to enemies, and all darkness is banished for a day.
evolves: If you meet the heir of Yin and fight beside them, both classes merge into a single whole.
cost: At night your features work at half strength.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Lioniiel's remains
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Lioniiel's remains form half of a pale circle; complete it with your own shadow while the choir sings its quietest verse.
secret: You must have saved a life at midnight, under no moon.
notice: [Half of the whole. The quiet is yours. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Lioniiel, the Unknown Shade of Yin, half of a pairing with Yang, tied loosely to Balance though neither half works well alone.
features: Skill: Moon Palm
Your unarmed strikes deal an extra 4d10 cold damage and the target's next attack has disadvantage.
Skill: Flowing Exchange
When you take damage, an ally within 30 feet regains hit points equal to half of it.
Ultimate: Midnight Stillness
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, enemies within 60 feet make a Wisdom save each turn or cannot move or act.
evolves: If you meet the heir of Yang and fight beside them, both classes merge into a single whole.
cost: In bright daylight your features work at half strength.

requires: Level 1+; the trace Sylph left behind
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire a warm breeze blows through an open window, Zephyrus's trace; make it laugh with you, and never mention her mother while you do.
secret: You must have spent a whole summer bringing joy to strangers.
notice: [Summer has come early. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Zephyrus, the soft giant of Summer and child of Sylph, who meets her grief with joy and burns anyone who names her mother.
features: Skill: Summer Breeze
As a bonus action, allies within 30 feet regain 1d6 hit points and are cured of being frightened.
Skill: Heat of Grief
When a creature within 60 feet mocks you or your allies, it takes 2d6 fire damage.
Ultimate: Endless Summer
Once per long rest, summer settles on a 300 foot area for 1 hour: allies inside have advantage on saves and cold cannot harm them.
evolves: If Zephyrus accepts you, you may call her warm wind once a season to end a winter early.
cost: You must never speak Sylph's name; doing so burns you for 2d6 fire damage.

requires: Level 67+; a piece of Ultheyr's remains
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Ultheyr's remains are an empty pedestal with a number carved beneath it; count what stands there until you reach nothing and can prove it.
secret: You must have lost everything you owned and started again from nothing.
notice: [Count: zero. Legendary class: Null-Count Knight.]
blurb: Follows Ultheyr, the Unbound Shape of Zero, the Void's law of nothing, an absence of number rather than of space.
features: Skill: Null Edge
Your weapon attacks deal an extra 6d10 force damage, and the target's bonuses to hit and AC count as zero against you.
Skill: Reduce to Nothing
Once per short rest, as a reaction, reduce the damage of one hit against you to zero.
Ultimate: Count to Zero
Once per long rest, a creature within 60 feet makes a Constitution save; on a failure, one of its numbers (hit points, speed, or spell slots) becomes zero for 1 round.
evolves: If you count a god's worshippers to zero without bloodshed, the class can unmake a contract.
cost: You can never keep more than you need; anything extra you hold is lost by dawn.

requires: Level 12+; a piece of Life's remains
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, a zombie risen from Life's remains wanders the mist; lead it to every floor it once walked, without ever striking it.
secret: You must have kept a loved one's corpse from rotting for a full season.
notice: [The flesh remembers. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Life down the road of Zombie, which needs flesh still mostly whole and keeps a little more power than a Skeleton, plus crude muscle memory.
features: Skill: Raise Flesh
Raise up to three zombies from intact corpses; each keeps slightly more power than a skeleton and moves as it did in life.
Skill: Muscle Memory
Each zombie keeps one physical trick from life (a shield block, a grapple, a charge) and gains +1 AC.
Ultimate: Shambling Host
Once per long rest, raise every intact corpse within 120 feet as zombies for 1 hour.
evolves: If you raise a fallen hero with their flesh intact, its muscle memory keeps their fighting style.
cost: You smell of rot; the living have disadvantage on reacting kindly to you.

n: Sworn Blade of the Deep Oath
requires: Level 45+; the trace Kakais left behind
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, Kakais's trace is a sword thrust into the dark floor; kneel, swear an oath to someone who is not present, and draw it under the full pressure of the deep.
secret: You must have fought beside the same lord or comrade in three battles and never once left their side.
notice: [Oath recorded. Battle and Loyalty together. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Kakais, the Quiet Shade of the Knight, a title earned only through Battle and Loyalty together, rarely through either alone.
features: Skill: Loyal Blade
When the one you are sworn to is attacked within 60 feet, you may move to them and make a weapon attack against the attacker as a reaction.
Skill: Battle Oath
While fighting for your oath, you gain +1 AC and your weapon attacks deal an extra 4d10 radiant damage.
Ultimate: Champion of the Crown
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you cannot be moved, charmed or frightened, and each of your hits deals an extra 10d10 radiant damage.
evolves: If the one you are sworn to dies and you keep the oath anyway, the class grants you their authority.
cost: You can never break your oath; doing so strips the class and every feature it gave.
